title: No automatic upload to Tidepool
body:
I am using version 3.4.0.0.

Upload to Nightscout happens automatically and readings show on Nightscout almost immediately.

No upload is made to Tidepool even after waiting more than 24 hours.  Sometimes when I tap on upload now, it asks me to enter user ID and password.  It then uploads.  
But, it does not keep uploading.

Is there a way to have it automatically upload to Tidepool the same as Nightscout?

I left it alone and stopped looking at Tidepool for a day or two.
This morning, I looked at it and I can see that it uploaded up to this morning.

It is quite possible that the automatic frequency has been increased intentionally.  But, it seems to still be working fine automatically.
I am going to confirm this by just leaving it alone and if I see it upload again automatically, I will close this issue.

Tidepool is not used for real time monitoring.  It is used for allowing your clinic and yourself to see everything in one place where you can analyze.
For that to work, there is no need to upload every day.  If a time comes that you go to use Tidepool and don't see recent values, you can manually do an upload to get any possible remaining items uploaded.

I'm almost sure this is a regression. Tidepool worked just fine until 3.4.0.0. It looks like it is getting blocked by connection options even when restrictions are met. The only way I got it working again was by logging in again and removing all restrictions on upload. Then, reapplying the restrictions got it back into the "BLOCKED" state.

Edit: Sidenote, there is also no way to clear the "SSID" field to take any Wifi SSID.

Thanks

But, there is no reason to keep this issue open considering.  We can always reopen if needed.

Thanks

I am running 3.4.1.0.
The problem persists.

This was solved for me by Jim Kelly on facebook.

I had to tap on logout under the Tidepool menu in AAPS.  Then, tap on login in the same menu and enter the credentials again in the browser that comes up.  
Since then, 14 hours ago, it has been uploading a new value every 5 minutes with a 3-hour delay non-stop.
It has stopped again.  It worked for a day or two and then stopped again.
It seems to be working fine with 3.4.2.0.
